title: VPC edge proxy: trace normalizer + tenant mapping for private collectors
creator: Diego Morales
description:
Problem: Private/VPC customers ingest telemetry through perimeter collectors and we currently forward traces with inconsistent tenant headers and sensitive attributes. This makes cross-tenant leakage, incorrect attribution in dashboards, and noisy latency/error signals more likely.

Proposal: Add a lightweight VPC edge proxy (stateless) that sits in front of on-prem/perimeter collectors to: 1) normalize trace context and propagate a canonical tenant_id field, 2) strip or redact PII fields from span attributes according to a tenant-safe policy, 3) verify and attach signed envelopes for air-gapped collectors, 4) add tenant-scoped sampling decisions and local adaptive buffering during bursts, and 5) emit enriched metrics/logs for downstream pipelines so latency/error dashboards can accurately show per-tenant SLOs.

Scope: Implement proxy and trace normalization, update collector ingestion contracts, instrument metric enrichers, add dashboard templates for per-tenant latency/error, and create rollout plan for Dedicated and Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: Edge proxy runs as a single binary/container and passes unit/integration tests in the e2e harness
All incoming trace payloads (OTLP/Jaeger/Zipkin) are normalized to include canonical tenant_id header or envelope before reaching core ingestion
Span attributes flagged by the tenant-safe policy are redacted or tokenized; policy configurable via central config for Dedicated customers
Proxy correctly verifies signed envelopes from air-gapped collectors and annotates traces with envelope_version and verification_status
Downstream metrics pipeline receives tenant-tagged latency and error counters for dashboarding without modifying existing storage schemas
Canary rollout (10% of traffic for a subset of customers) shows no increase in trace loss and latency impact < 2ms p50 for proxy hop during steady traffic
Dashboards updated to include per-tenant p50/p95 latency, error rate, and per-model tail latency with links to example trace samples
Documentation and runbook created: how to enable/disable redaction, sampling overrides, and emergency bypass
design_decisions: Normalization contract: accept OTLP, Jaeger, Zipkin; translate to internal canonical envelope with 'tenant_id' and 'tenant_scope' fields; reject payloads without signed envelope for air-gapped customers
Redaction model: whitelist attribute keys allowed; default deny for unknown attributes. Use tokenization for high-cardinality user identifiers to preserve joinability without exposing raw PII
Sampling model: proxy makes early sampling decision based on tenant SLO config and recent burst metrics. It attaches sampling_decision metadata for downstream caches to respect KV cache consistency

Verification: use ed25519 signatures for envelope verification. Store public keys in k/v config service with rotation window. Fail-open policy for non-airgapped Dedicated with audit log; fail-closed for air-gapped when signature missing
Performance: keep proxy single-threaded worker-per-core with fast-path for already-normalized traces; avoid expensive JSON parsing for common binary OTLP protobuf path
Metrics emission: counter labels include tenant_id (hashed), region, ingress_latency_ms_bucket; no raw attributes emitted to Prometheus to avoid PII leakage
rollout_plan: Dev: unit tests + local e2e harness (2 days)
Canary: deploy to staging and 10% of Dedicated customers (1 week), monitor trace loss and proxy latency
Incremental rollout: expand to remaining Dedicated customers over 2 weeks with feature-flag toggles
Private/VPC: ship configuration manifest and operator chart for on-prem install; recommend 1 proxy per availability boundary; require signed envelope enforcement as opt-in initially
Fallback: automatic bypass route in control plane to skip proxy for a tenant for 30 minutes in case of regressions
Post-mortem: collect metrics for 48 hours post-rollout and validate dashboards against baseline
tasks: Implement proxy binary: normalize + redaction + signature verification (ENG)
Update collector ingestion contract docs and example configs (Docs)
Instrument downstream metrics pipeline to accept tenant-tagged latency/error (Infra)
Create per-tenant dashboard templates and add to dashboard library (Observability)
Add e2e tests and load test scenario to our benchmark suite (Perf)
Security review and threat model update (Security)
Rollout scripts and feature flags in control plane (Platform)
Customer communication: advisory and onboarding guide for Private customers (Support)
Create runbook for emergency bypass and signature key rotation (SRE)
notes: We intentionally avoid adding tenant_id to raw span names to reduce risk of sensitive identifiers appearing in full-text search indices
Edge proxy will be marked experimental for 6 weeks; monitoring thresholds are conservative to detect any trace loss quickly
Perf baseline: initial microbench shows <1.8ms added p50 for protobuf OTLP fast-path on m5.large equivalent; plan to run larger GPU-edge synthetic tests
Discussed tokenization approach with Privacy team; decided token replacement with salt per-tenant for limited joinability
Consider future work: envelope compression, aggregated sampling across collectors, and OTEL semantic conventions mapping
